nodes.mechanism: Mechanism of action

nodes.label: Allicin
nodes.benefit: Potent antimicrobial, lowers blood pressure, anti-inflammatory.

nodes.label: Hypertension
nodes.mechanism: Promotes nitric oxide synthesis leading to vasodilation.

nodes.label: Hyperlipidemia
nodes.mechanism: Inhibits cholesterol synthesis (HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor behavior).

nodes.label: Dodecenal
nodes.benefit: Antibacterial compound specifically effective against Salmonella.

nodes.label: Heavy Metal Detoxification
nodes.mechanism: Chelating agents in cilantro bind to lead and mercury facilitating excretion.

nodes.label: Bone Health
nodes.mechanism: Extremely high Vitamin K supports osteocalcin carboxylation.

nodes.label: Cuminaldehyde
nodes.benefit: Stimulates salivary glands and digestive enzymes.

nodes.label: Digestion
nodes.mechanism: Increases activity of digestive enzymes (amylase, protease, lipase).

nodes.label: Nausea / Motion Sickness
nodes.mechanism: Gingerols antagonize 5-HT3 receptors in the gut, reducing nausea without CNS side effects.

nodes.label: Inflammation
nodes.mechanism: Inhibits COX-2 enzyme similarly to NSAIDs.

nodes.label: Policosanols
nodes.benefit: Waxy alcohols found in cane, potential cholesterol benefits (trace amounts).

nodes.label: Hydration / Energy
nodes.mechanism: Rapid glucose source combined with water (Aguapanela) restores glycogen.

nodes.label: Common Cold (Folk)
nodes.mechanism: Hot aguapanela with lemon soothes throat (demulcent effect).

nodes.label: Hydration
nodes.mechanism: Critical electrolyte for fluid retention and nerve transmission.

nodes.label: Bioactive Peptides
nodes.benefit: Generated during fermentation (depends on cheese type).

nodes.label: Beta-sitosterol
nodes.benefit: Plant sterol that helps maintain healthy cholesterol levels.

nodes.label: Cardiovascular Health
nodes.mechanism: Lowers LDL cholesterol and increases HDL via phytosterols and monounsaturated fats.

nodes.label: Metabolic Syndrome
nodes.mechanism: High potassium and fiber improve blood pressure and satiety.

nodes.label: Citric Acid
nodes.benefit: Enhances iron absorption, prevents kidney stones.

nodes.label: Iron Deficiency Anemia
nodes.mechanism: Vitamin C and citric acid significantly increase non-heme iron absorption (from beans/lentils) by converting ferric iron to ferrous iron.

nodes.label: Kidney Stones
nodes.mechanism: Citrate binds urinary calcium, preventing crystallization.

nodes.label: Energy Recovery
nodes.mechanism: High glycemic index carbohydrates replenish muscle glycogen rapidly after exercise.

nodes.label: Digestive Tolerance
nodes.mechanism: Low fiber and low residue make it ideal for managing gastrointestinal distress (BRAT diet).

nodes.label: Gluten
nodes.benefit: Structural protein giving elasticity to dough.

nodes.label: Energy
nodes.mechanism: Dense source of complex carbohydrates.

nodes.label: Eye Health
nodes.mechanism: Reduces risk of cataracts and macular degeneration by filtering blue light in the retina.

nodes.label: Anthocyanins
nodes.benefit: Antioxidant found in the red skin.

nodes.label: Type 2 Diabetes
nodes.mechanism: High fiber and resistant starch lower glycemic response and improve insulin sensitivity.

nodes.label: Gut Health
nodes.mechanism: Prebiotic fermentation produces Short-Chain Fatty Acids (SCFAs) like butyrate.

nodes.label: Weight Management
nodes.mechanism: High protein and fiber content increase satiety and reduce total energy intake.

nodes.label: Muscle Growth (Sarcopenia)
nodes.mechanism: High quality protein rich in Leucine stimulates mTOR pathway.

nodes.label: Thiamin (B1)
nodes.benefit: Critical for energy metabolism and nerve function.

nodes.label: Energy Metabolism
nodes.mechanism: Pork is one of the richest sources of Thiamin, essential for converting glucose to energy.

nodes.label: Choline
nodes.benefit: Essential for brain development and liver function.

nodes.label: Eye Health (AMD)
nodes.mechanism: Macular pigment optical density improvement via Lutein/Zeaxanthin absorption.

nodes.label: Cognitive Function
nodes.mechanism: Choline is a precursor to acetylcholine, a neurotransmitter for memory and muscle control.

nodes.label: Omega-3 (DHA/EPA)
nodes.benefit: Anti-inflammatory fatty acids (levels vary by species).

nodes.label: Brain Health
nodes.mechanism: DHA is a major structural component of the brain.

nodes.label: Muscle Maintenance
nodes.mechanism: High bioavailability protein supports myofibrillar protein synthesis.

nodes.label: Lycopene
nodes.benefit: Bioavailability increased by cooking in oil.

nodes.label: Isoflavones
nodes.benefit: Phytoestrogens with antioxidant properties (varies by fermentation).

nodes.label: Vegetarian Nutrition
nodes.mechanism: Provides Umami flavor (Glutamate) increasing palatability of plant-based dishes.

nodes.label: Diabetes Management
nodes.mechanism: Hypoglycemic effects via increased insulin secretion and sensitivity.

nodes.label: Zeaxanthin
nodes.benefit: Carotenoid giving yellow color, supports eye health.

nodes.label: Hypertension / Cardiovascular Health
nodes.mechanism: High potassium content counters sodium effects, relaxing blood vessel walls.

nodes.label: Digestive Health
nodes.mechanism: High digestibility starch (easily broken down) suitable for convalescence.

nodes.label: Kukoamines
nodes.benefit: Compounds in potato skin linked to lowering blood pressure.

nodes.label: Satiety & Weight Management
nodes.mechanism: High Satiety Index (highest of common foods) reduces subsequent calorie intake.

nodes.label: Immune Support
nodes.mechanism: Contains 200% DV of Vitamin C per 100g, supporting white blood cell function.

nodes.label: Energy Boost
nodes.mechanism: As the plantain ripens, resistant starch converts to simple sugars, providing immediate energy.

nodes.label: Mood Regulation
nodes.mechanism: Vitamin B6 is a cofactor for serotonin and dopamine synthesis.

nodes.label: Resistant Starch (Type 2)
nodes.benefit: Acts as soluble fiber, feeding beneficial gut bacteria.

nodes.label: Glycemic Control
nodes.mechanism: Reduces postprandial glucose response and insulin sensitivity due to indigestible fraction.

nodes.label: Prostate Health
nodes.mechanism: Lycopene accumulates in prostate tissue and reduces DNA damage via antioxidant action.

nodes.label: Gluten Sensitivity (Celiac)
nodes.mechanism: Naturally gluten-free carbohydrate source.

nodes.label: Vision (Night Blindness)
nodes.mechanism: Beta-carotene converts to Retinol, essential for rhodopsin formation in the retina.
